title: Gateway endpoint experiment_id on create/update: check omission with `is not None`, never truthiness, so explicit "" and 0 are parsed and not silently dropped
answers: Creating a gateway endpoint with usage_tracking enabled ended up with a null experiment ID even though I passed an experiment_id. Why?
Updating a gateway endpoint with experiment_id set to 0 or an empty string: is it treated as omitted?
Where is the optional experiment_id handled when creating or updating a gateway endpoint in the SQL store?
body:
Path: Gateway endpoint create and update in the SQL tracking store, through mlflow/store/tracking/gateway/sqlalchemy_mixin.py:create_gateway_endpoint and update_gateway_endpoint. These handle the optional experiment_id that links an endpoint to an experiment for usage tracking, and they call mlflow/utils/validation.py:_parse_experiment_id to convert it.
Rule: Treat experiment_id as omitted only when it is None (`experiment_id is not None` before parsing, else store None). Do not use truthiness such as `if experiment_id`, which sends "" and 0 down the omitted path. With this, "" raises INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE and 0 is stored as experiment 0.
Symptom: On create with usage tracking on, an explicit experiment_id of "" or 0 was treated as absent, so the endpoint was stored with a null experiment ID and usage tracking was effectively disabled instead of the value being rejected or used.
Constraints: Applies only to optional-ID handling in gateway endpoint create/update. Search and trace paths have no omission semantics, so they parse every value they receive. Existing tests cover "0" and 0 being accepted and "" being rejected.
applies: Gateway endpoint create/update in the SQL tracking store, and any new optional ID field where 0 or empty string is a legal or illegal explicit value.
says: Setting the experiment identifier to zero on a gateway endpoint silently disables usage tracking.
Gateway endpoint usage tracking does not link when using the default experiment zero.
Entering an empty experiment identifier on a gateway endpoint should fail validation instead of saving.
Updating a gateway endpoint with experiment zero resets the tracking experiment to empty.
Creating a gateway endpoint with usage tracking ignores an explicit experiment zero.
search: Gateway endpoint creation and updates in mlflow/store/tracking/gateway/sqlalchemy_mixin.py must check optional experiment_id omission using `is not None` rather than truthiness before calling _parse_experiment_id. Using truthiness treats explicit values of zero or empty string as omitted, silently disabling usage tracking with a null experiment instead of storing experiment 0 or raising INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE. This rule applies to create_gateway_endpoint and update_gateway_endpoint in the SQL tracking store, but excludes search and trace paths which have no omission semantics and parse every value.
